title: scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM-Based Single-Cell Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference.   Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. translated_title: scOPD：面向基于大语言模型的单细胞注释的路由式在策略自蒸馏框架
translated_abstract: 动机：大语言模型（LLMs）在单细胞注释方面已展现出潜力，但现有训练方法主要依赖标量结果奖励，这对中间生物推理过程提供的监督十分有限。批次级别的注释尤其具有挑战性，因为它需要同时解决局部细胞身份识别与全局一对一匹配约束，任何一个局部错误都可能影响整个分配结果。此外，单次推理过程无法为定位不确定的预测提供充分证据。这些局限性要求在训练阶段引入细粒度的推理监督，并在推理阶段实现不确定性感知的细化。结果：为应对这些挑战，我们提出了scOPD，一个用于基于大语言模型单细胞注释的在策略自蒸馏框架。在推理微调之后，scOPD自适应地将合格的rollout路由至基于奖励的优化，而错误的rollout则接收先验……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: scOPD提出了一种面向大语言模型批次级单细胞注释的在策略自蒸馏框架，通过自适应地将合格rollout路由至基于奖励的优化、并利用错误rollout进行自蒸馏，为中间生物推理提供细粒度监督。
en_tdlr: scOPD is an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based batch-level single-cell annotation that adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization while distilling knowledge from erroneous rollouts, providing fine-grained supervision for intermediate biological reasoning.
